free_tier_limits: Free only for non-commercial applications, limited to two reference APIs and 1,000 queries per day per API key/reference; commercial or higher-volume use requires a paid agreement.
paid_plans: Commercial/higher-volume plans available via Merriam-Webster sales
rate_limits: 1,000 queries per API key per day; contact Merriam-Webster for higher-volume use.

description: Merriam-Webster's Dictionary API provides programmatic access to trusted English dictionary and thesaurus content, including definitions, pronunciations, etymologies, synonyms, antonyms, and example sentences. Developers get free API keys for the Collegiate Dictionary, Thesaurus, and other reference products, making it a standard choice for language tools, writing apps, and educational products.
resolution_notes: All four disputes confirmed via live official docs. base_url: auditor correct — https://dictionaryapi.com/products shows paths under https://www.dictionaryapi.com/api/v3/references/{dict}/json/{word}. docs_url: auditor correct — official portal is https://dictionaryapi.com/. free_tier_limits & rate_limits: auditor correct — https://dictionaryapi.com/products states free non-commercial use, two APIs, 1000 queries/day per key; commercial via sales.
